text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API queue growth detected in us-east-1. Autoscaler entering oscillation (scale up/down loop). Provisioner heartbeats missing for 3m. p95 and p99 token latency >= 20s for several tenants. Incoming queue +120% in 5m.
maya: acked. paging oncall.
maya: I'm oncall. grabbing context... any customer-visible 5xxs?
leo: seeing 504 spikes, long waits. backend logs show repeated node churn in gpu-pool-7.
sanjay: provisioner shows heartbeat flaps to cloud provider, hitting API 429s. scaling calls retried and failing.
kati: confirmed: autoscaler cooldown 2m, but leader election churn is 30-90s causing repeated scale actions.
maya: mitigation options?
leo: immediate: enable model-fallback routing for high-latency routes to smaller-quantized variants.
leo: second: pause autoscaler leader elections by setting `--leader-elect=false` on provisioner leader for short window.
sanjay: provider quota hit looks like root cause. we can apply transient quota request, but that's slow.
zoe: can we throttle ingest from noisy tenants as a short-term fix?
maya: yes. open a temporary tenant-rate policy: `rate_limit: 50qps` for campaign-* tenants.
ash: product confirms a marketing campaign rolled out at 19:00 that matches the tenant IDs in spike.
leo: rolling throttle now: `curl -X POST https://api.internal/limits -d '{"selector":"tenant:campaign-*","qps":50}'`
incident-bot: deploy job started: deploy/limits-update #457 -> success
leo: enabling fallback routing to model-redwood-sm-quant (lower mem) for request size > 1k tokens.
maya: done. rerouting 38% of queued requests. queue drain rate improving.
sanjay: applied provider-side exponential backoff fix to provisioner clients to prevent 429 loops.
kati: bumping autoscaler cooldown to 6m and disabling aggressive downscales for 10m.
maya: monitoring p95/p99. current p95=6.2s down from 22s, p99=18s down from 72s.
zoe: customer impact: 112 tenants saw degraded perf, 8 tenants had timeouts leading to retries/client errors. CS notified.
ash: sending customer comms draft to legal/commops.
leo: plan: 1) keep throttles for 30m 2) request provider quota bump 3) revert fallbacks after stable 30m.
maya: handoff to night oncall @ 1709005000. leaving runbook notes in incident ticket: INC-17090.
maya: anyone else?
ash: good job. capture root cause analysis once logs fully ingested.
kati: adding postmortem owners: leo, sanjay, kati.
zoom-bot: meeting created: "Incident INC-17090 RCA" tomorrow 09:00
maya: closing incident channel after handoff. :white_check_mark:
